niesymetryczna głębokość przy monitorach, bez tylnej ściany

config.model: P26 Neumann rectangular box and 2-source transfer p/U; each cabinet one pressure lumped source. T/S C02 / C05 + fixed B12-03 five IIR, no dynamic room loading
config.optimization: At sweet spot, 20-80Hz relative span minimization with >=-3dB at 40Hz vs equal undelayed channels and <=+3dB change of diagnostic neighbor deviation. Still NOT real calibration.

controls.selectivity: No user-verified cabinet coordinates; optimization not installation recommendation
controls.comparative_headroom: not assessed; normalized at 40Hz; consult B12-04 and measured driver THD/compression

limitations: Even 30-50dB modal troughs are artifacts of unverified rectangular rigid-room damping and null locations, NOT guaranteed real measured equalization
T60 and uniform mode relaxation are artificial independent scenarios, no absorption boundaries or openings
Room transfer normalized by 40Hz; no absolute SPL in room, no measured room gain and no benchmarking clean 20Hz SPL against ADAM official 1m maximum
No measured monitor/sub crossover phase, no 8-channel integrated-system tuning, no geometry of furniture or confirmed exact source positions
A-C symmetric source placement may be impractical; C excluded for cabinet width; source points represent diaphragm face, not exact cabinet center
Two STX in one sealed sub not the user's baseline one-driver per-sub; two sub cabinets require four STX and two amplifiers
DSP protection not evaluated, mathematical gain/delay is a screening grid only; NEVER import into miniDSP without measurements
ADAM Sub15 525mm depth exceeds 500mm prototype limit but serves as performance reference
